text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time had passed since running through the first three years of the Twinkle Series alongside Believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Morning. After tidying up my appearance,
I leave my room in the Trainers' Dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And before heading off to the academy—
I check the contents of the mailbox by the front door.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once I finally reached the trainer's office,
I gently and carefully unfolded the letter...
that I had precious slipped into my bag earlier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I slowly scan the neat, orderly lines of polite handwriting,
slightly small and delicate, just as they always are.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"To Trainer <username>,

How have you been? I am doing very well."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "‘I've gotten quite used to life in America.’"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"The vast flower field I saw the other day when tagging along with my grandfather's work was so beautiful.
I've enclosed a photo with this letter."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I pull the contents out of the envelope, take a look, and let out a small breath without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The letter continued, saying they got to talk
with the person managing this flower garden
and were deeply impressed by their dedication and skill."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smiling at such a characteristically "Believe" experience, I carefully put the letter and photo back in the envelope and tucked it into the drawer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This makes the fifth letter I've received.
—Believe is no longer here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, far away even from Tracen Academy,
she is spending her time with her grandfather in America.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I can still clearly remember Believe telling me
that that was what she wanted to do,
as if it were only yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There is one thing—
I feel a true sense of accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In the Sprinters Stakes we challenged in our third year.
I... accomplished one mission.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Do you want to retire?" My lips tremble as I start to ask,
and I fall completely silent.
I feel as though saying it aloud would make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Do you want to retire?" My lips tremble as I start to ask,
and I fall completely silent.
I feel as though saying it aloud would make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even so, it seemed Believe had pretty much figured out what he wanted to say anyway."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not thinking about... retiring right now, or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still, while keeping that in mind as an option……
I want to think about it.
I want to take a little time…… and really think it over.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
What is the job that I should be doing?
...That's what I want to think through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we were so busy with leave-of-absence paperwork...
that before we knew it, the day had already come
to see Believe off.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Over there... once I arrive in America,
I'll be staying with my grandfather."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Because it was my grandfather who gave me
the catalyst to first recognize my job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Back at where it all began for me.
I'll go reflect and look at myself once more.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm heading out.
Trainer, you too...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Take care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That was the last face-to-face exchange I had with her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that point on, Believe never returned to Japan even once,
and the occasional letters she sends remain
my only connection to her...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling lonely, Bili-Tra?!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Watch how you say that!!!!
choice_data_list: Ahaha... You two came to see me again, huh?
Ahaha... You two came to visit again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I ended up feeling terribly lonely today,
so I came over.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: After all, none of the other girls could ever hope to stop the reckless, blazing speed of Durandal and myself.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I kept ranking up from my homeroom teacher, to the head of year, to the vice principal,
and tomorrow, I'm finally scheduled to get a personal scolding from Chairwoman Akikawa herself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! I... I always start out
as the straight man, so...
Why does this happen every single time...?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I sorely miss Believe's calm, deadpan comebacks. I also want her to share some of those side dishes from her bento again—they're entirely brown, but outrageously delicious.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's why at times like this, there's nothing better than seeing your face.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Because ever since Believe left,
every time I look at you, you've got such a pitiful, sniffling, gloomy face from loneliness."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing someone tossed around by feelings just like yours—
only on an absurdly bigger scale—calms you down.
That happens pretty often, right?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I am so terribly sorry, Trainer!!
She didn't mean any harm!!
She never means any harm, ever!!
choice_data_list: I-It's fine, it's fine. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, I mean no offense.
I am merely stating the facts."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it's strange.
You probably knew you'd end up making
such a lonely face, and yet—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: You sent Believe off without any hesitation, didn't you?
choice_data_list: That's... because I wanted to, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To think it'd be pointed out directly to my face like this...
I could never bring myself to say 'I'm not lonely.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Yet, how could something like that—something so trivial—ever hinder her steps?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By now, she had become the ultimate artisan—peerless when it came to sprinting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she wishes
to find a new job, then...
choice_data_list: (Giving each other a push forward... that's what work buddies are for, right?)
(Giving that little push... that's what colleagues are for, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Calstone Light O and the others
kept chatting lively, sharing fond memories
of Believe and more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that day, for the first time in a while, I spent hours picturing Believe in all kinds of moments...
and after the two left, the silence really tugged at my heartstrings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after some time had passed once more,
—I found a letter in the mailbox.
choice_data_list: That makes six letters now, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like usual, I open the letter in the trainer's office.
...Except—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Expecting neatly organized lines of text as usual, what met my eyes were merely three lines.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the moment I understood
the meaning written there—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had dashed out of the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "To Trainer <username>"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "I'm returning to Japan."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "From Believe"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
!!
Huh... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Hello. ...It has been a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I instinctively returned her matter-of-fact bow,
only then snapping to my senses.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Umm.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you have some time?
Please let me talk to you properly."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I need to speak with my Trainer.
Could you wait over there for a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ――Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her face still carried a childlike innocence,
the Umamusume gave a firm nod
and dashed off into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I found myself staring intently at her retreating back...
Believe spoke up quietly.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"She is... an aspiring Tracen Academy student
whom I met over there."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No. In fact—
he says he wants to join our team.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she was watching.
My race in the Sprinters Stakes, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: And that made me want to get faster, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...'I want to be the fastest.'
That's what she said.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
…………Trainer.
I—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I didn't need anything.
I told you before, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If only I could do a good job.
If only I could properly carry out the job I decided on.
That was all I ever wanted.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, I wouldn't say
I've never thought about it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
During hard times. When I felt like stopping in my tracks,
to be honest, the thought crossed my mind a few times.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Just what on earth am I doing this for?"
"What meaning is there in coming this far?"
...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I still wanted to see it through to the end.
Because this is my job—the one I chose for myself.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I will do it right.
I will see it through to the end.
I will keep going until I can do it."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I was able to see it through.
That was all that mattered.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: But...—
choice_data_list: ...So she was watching that after all.
...So she was watching that after all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking no reward, desiring no applause.
Enduring day after day, quietly tending to her work.
Looking at her quiet back—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone was definitely watching.
Moved by that earnest devotion,
their heart trembled with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...That's not why I did it.
I'm sure that won't change.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Even so, I...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...This is the kind of work I've always wanted to do.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Would you work with me again?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I want to entrust this to you.
...Because it's you, I know I can."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Running again with you.
That is my next job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Will you accept this?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's head home before it gets too late.
We need to get back and rest.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: To prepare for tomorrow's work, as well.
